from fractions import Fraction

# Represent each physical ball separately, even when labels are identical.
balls = [("red", 1)] * 2 + [("red", 2)] * 4
balls += [("blue", 1)] + [("blue", 2)] * 2
n = len(balls)

# (1): Exhaust all ordered draws with replacement.
favorable = sum(
    ((color1 == "red") + (color2 == "red") == 1)
    and number1 + number2 == 3
    for color1, number1 in balls
    for color2, number2 in balls
)
p1 = Fraction(favorable, n * n)

# (2): Exhaust all ordered draws of distinct physical balls.
pairs = [(i, j) for i in range(n) for j in range(n) if i != j]
total = len(pairs)
count_a = sum(balls[i][0] == "red" for i, j in pairs)
count_b = sum(balls[j][1] == 1 for i, j in pairs)
count_ab = sum(
    balls[i][0] == "red" and balls[j][1] == 1
    for i, j in pairs
)
pa = Fraction(count_a, total)
pb = Fraction(count_b, total)
pab = Fraction(count_ab, total)
independent = pab == pa * pb

checks = [
    ("(1)", p1 == Fraction(8, 81)),
    ("(2) P(A)", pa == Fraction(2, 3)),
    ("(2) P(B)", pb == Fraction(1, 3)),
    ("(2) independence", independent),
]

print("(1) Exact probability:", p1)
print("(2) P(A):", pa)
print("(2) P(B):", pb)
print("(2) P(A and B):", pab)
print("(2) P(A) * P(B):", pa * pb)
print("(2) Independent:", independent)
for label, passed in checks:
    print(label + ":", "CHECK PASS" if passed else "CHECK FAIL")
print("Overall:", "CHECK PASS" if all(ok for _, ok in checks) else "CHECK FAIL")
